description: This file defines a custom schema filter for Swagger/OpenAPI in the eShopOnWeb project. It implements the ISchemaFilter interface to modify the generated OpenAPI schema by removing specific properties from the schema definitions.

classes.name: CustomSchemaFilters
classes.description: A class implementing ISchemaFilter to customize OpenAPI schema generation by removing specified properties.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the OpenApiSchema by removing the 'CorrelationId' property from the schema properties.
